description: Update metadata fields for a saved asset. Pass `references` to record reference rights and permitted uses for a saved asset; that annotation is not a generation input, so it appends a new recipe snapshot.

business_fields.description: Stored with the asset but not searchable; put anything that should be findable via search into tags instead. Only the keys you pass are merged into the stored object: a key whose value is null is removed, and every other stored key is kept unchanged.

allowed_uses.description: Purposes this reference may serve, for example identity, style, world, wardrobe, composition. Once set, any purpose outside the list is treated as forbidden.

forbidden_uses.description: Purposes this reference must not serve. A forbidden use always overrides the same allowed use.

rights.description: Rights declarations for the reference image. Unstated fields stay unknown; silence is never recorded as permission.

name: asset_update_metadata
